I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded, and it names no format.

The project's decision catalogue lists only four records: HTTPS everywhere, verification on all builds, rustls, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL. None of them covers serialisation. The earlier sessions that mention msgpack and cbor only show a one-word message from the user each, not a decision, so I didn't treat them as one.

The Muninn heartbeat also reports 20 hook runs that started and never finished, so a hook may be exceeding its timeout. The catalogue itself said it was the complete list, so I relied on it. The details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` if you want to look.
